title: Fish, Acute Toxicity Testing
species: Various fish species (e.g., Danio rerio, Pimephales promelas, Cyprinus carpio, Oryzias latipes, Poecilia reticulata, Lepomis macrochirus, Oncorhynchus mykiss); also estuarine/marine species (Gasterosteus aculeatus, Cyprinodon variegatus, Dicentrarchus labrax, Pagrus major)
animals: Minimum 7 fish per test concentration and in control(s)
dose_groups: At least 5 concentrations in a geometric series with factor preferably not exceeding 2.2 + control(s)

title: Avian Dietary Toxicity Test
species: Various avian species: mallard duck, bobwhite quail, pigeon, Japanese quail, ring-necked pheasant, red-legged partridge
duration: 8 days minimum (5 days exposure + 3 days recovery)
animals: 10 birds per group (2 control groups + 1 treatment group per concentration)
dose_groups: At least 5 dietary concentration levels + 2 control groups
route: Dietary exposure (test substance mixed in feed)

title: Acute Dermal Toxicity: Fixed Dose Procedure
animals: 1 animal per dose in range-finding; 2 animals per dose in main study (single sex)
dose_groups: Fixed doses (50, 200, 1000, 2000 mg/kg bw) in stepwise procedure
route: Dermal application (to at least 10% of total body surface area)

title: Acute Inhalation Toxicity
species: Rat (preferred); justification required if other species used
animals: Traditional: 5 males + 5 females per concentration; C x t: 1 animal/sex per concentration/time point
dose_groups: At least 3 concentration levels (Traditional) or multiple concentrations x durations (C x t)

title: Acute Dermal Irritation/Corrosion
species: Albino rabbit (preferred); healthy young adult rabbits used
duration: Up to 14 days observation (4-hour dermal exposure period)
animals: 1 animal in initial test; up to 2 additional in confirmatory test (maximum 3 total)
dose_groups: Single dose level (0.5 mL liquid or 0.5 g solid/paste); sequential patch application
route: Dermal application (single dose to approximately 6 cm2 of skin)

title: Skin Sensitisation
species: Guinea pig (healthy young adult, male and/or female)
animals: GPMT: min 10 test + 5 control (recommended 20+10); Buehler: min 20 test + 10 control
route: Dermal (intradermal injection and/or epidermal topical application)

title: Repeated Dose 28-Day Oral Toxicity Study in Rodents
species: Rat (preferred); other rodent species may be used with justification
animals: At least 10 per dose level (5 female + 5 male)
dose_groups: At least 3 test groups + 1 control group

title: Repeated Dose 90-Day Oral Toxicity Study in Rodents
species: Rat (preferred); other rodent species (e.g., the mouse) may be used with justification
animals: At least 20 per dose level (10 female + 10 male)
dose_groups: At least 3 dose levels + 1 concurrent control

title: Repeated Dose 90-day Oral Toxicity Study in Non-Rodents
species: Dog (beagle preferred); swine/mini-pigs may also be used; primates not recommended
animals: At least 8 animals (4 female + 4 male) per dose level
dose_groups: At least 3 dose levels + 1 concurrent control group
route: Oral (gavage, diet, drinking water, or capsules)

title: Repeated Dose Dermal Toxicity: 21/28-day Study
species: Adult rat (preferred); rabbit or guinea pig may also be used
animals: At least 10 per dose level (5 female + 5 male)
dose_groups: At least 3 dose levels + 1 control group
route: Dermal (at least 6 hours/day to ~10% of total body surface area)

title: 28-day (subacute) inhalation toxicity study
species: Rat (preferred); other rodent species require justification
duration: 28 days (6 hours/day; 5 days/week; 7 days/week also allowed)
animals: Minimum 5 male and 5 female per concentration level
dose_groups: At least 3 concentration levels + concurrent negative (air) or vehicle control

title: Prenatal developmental toxicity study
species: Rat (preferred rodent); rabbit (preferred non-rodent); justification required for other species
duration: From implantation (~day 5 post-mating) to one day prior to expected delivery
animals: Sufficient females to yield ~20 with implantation sites at necropsy (minimum 16)
dose_groups: At least 3 dose levels + 1 concurrent control group
route: Oral (gavage preferred); other routes require justification

title: Two-generation reproduction toxicity study
duration: P generation: ≥10 weeks pre-mating + mating + gestation + lactation to F1 weaning; F1: weaning to F2 weaning
animals: Sufficient to yield preferably ≥20 pregnant females per group
dose_groups: At least 3 dose levels + 1 concurrent control group
route: Oral (diet, drinking water, or gavage) preferred

title: Acute Oral Toxicity – Acute Toxic Class Method
species: Rat (preferred rodent); other rodent species may be used; normally females
animals: 3 animals per step; stepwise procedure (typically 2-4 steps; 6-12 animals total)
dose_groups: Stepwise: fixed starting doses of 5, 50, 300, or 2000 mg/kg; limit test at 2000 mg/kg

title: Uterotrophic Bioassay in Rodents: A short-term screening test for oestrogenic properties
species: Rat (preferred; Sprague-Dawley/Wistar validated); mice for OVX adult method only
duration: 3 consecutive days (immature/OVX rat); 7 consecutive days (OVX mouse); necropsy ~24h after last dose

title: Hershberger Bioassay in Rats: A Short-term Screening Assay for (Anti)Androgenic Properties
species: Rat (Sprague Dawley or Wistar recommended); castrated peripubertal males; Fisher 344 not recommended
duration: 10 consecutive days; necropsy ~24h after last dose
dose_groups: Androgenic: min 2 test groups + TP positive + vehicle negative; Antiandrogenic: min 3 test groups + TP+FT positive + TP-only negative

title: Chronic Toxicity Studies
species: Rat (preferred rodent); other rodents (e.g., mouse) may be used; non-rodents possible
duration: Normally 12 months (daily dosing); shorter (6 or 9 months) or longer (18 or 24 months) possible
animals: At least 20 per sex per group (rodents); minimum 4 per sex per group (non-rodents)
dose_groups: At least 3 dose levels + 1 concurrent control
route: Oral (diet, drinking water, or gavage) preferred; dermal and inhalation also possible
